title: [yencoding] Reject =ypart with begin > end at parse time
description: Skoll LOW-61: parse_ypart does not validate begin <= end. A malformed header like =ypart begin=100 end=1 parses successfully. The assembler rejects it later, but if the assembler is not used, callers get invalid DecodedPart with part_begin > part_end. Add validation in parse_ypart or the decode layer.
close_reason: Added begin <= end validation in parse_ypart. Returns InvalidHeader when begin > end.
